conbody.p: The front-view function assists with safe driving by displaying activity ahead of the vehicle on the navigation system, according to your selected settings.

section.title: Operating conditions
section.p: The Surround View Monitor’s Front-view function activates when you are parking under the following conditions:

li.p: Your vehicle’s gear is in P (Park), N (Neutral), or D (Drive) at a speed below 10 km/h (6 mph), and you press the Parking/View button (1).
You shift the gear from R (Reverse) to N (Neutral) or D (Drive) at a speed below 10 km/h (6 mph).
Forward Parking Distance Warning warns you while the gear is set to D (Drive).
*(If you have selected SetupVehicleDriver AssistanceParking SafetySurround View Monitor Auto On on the infotainment system screen).

section.title: Non-operating conditions
section.p: Press the view switching button (2) on the Surround View Monitor to select Top View, Front View, Side View, or Wide View.
The Surround View Monitor’s front-view function turns OFF when you are parking under the following conditions:

li.p: You shift the gear to P (Park) or R (Reverse).
You press the back button (3) on the Surround View Monitor screen.
You press the infotainment system power button (4).

note.p: When the Surround View Monitor Front View activates, the last view you used displays.
